purpose: PRD-09 usage reader fixture: a real Claude Code 2.1.283 headless run, Anthropic Messages over HTTP with SSE replies carrying token usage

claude-code-2.1.283-e01.jsonl.conversion: In a build box, each stream's v5 segments were joined in source order into one line (keys stream, source, exchange, method or status, content_type, label, first and last wall, text). That is a subset of the m2-openai line keys: no message_index, retained_segments or mono_ns. Masks kept as recorded; ids, offsets, audits and end records (all complete) dropped; the source had no request-id header.
claude-code-2.1.283-e01.jsonl.checked_in_box: every line parses as JSON; both replies hold message_start and message_delta usage. Exchange 1: input 10, cache creation 7637, cache read 13689, output 356, output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens 182. Exchange 2: input 8, cache creation 511, cache read 21326, output 61, output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens 55. The thinking count is the reasoning token number the reader should take where given.
